name: Fee sharing

subjectOf.text: Enforcing a protocol in which all work fees are shared with the expertise produces a positive feedback loop: more fees raise the worth of reputation, which makes sem tokens more desirable than one time fees, which makes vested experts police the system carefully, which makes the system more secure.
subjectOf.abstract: The more fees are sent to the platform, the more the reputation is worth; which means the sem tokens will be more desirable to experts than one-time fees; which means the system will be carefully policed by vested experts; this makes the system more secure
